prior.note: -45 inherited from R4B3 historical grid, not new selection; coordinate relative to end and span of supplied fit window

transition.bank: exact R4B6 latent generation; old frozen geometry + envelope + classifier

joint.fit: same single start per strategy, equal 80 function evaluations; log gap, log-time frequency, envelope exponent; linear sin/cos/offset profiled; residual divided by fixed local RMS scale estimated solely from fit samples; no true t* or envelope supplied; geometry unavailable counts separately, no fallback
joint.admission: candidate estimator diagnostic only; joint fit assumes DSS and is not standalone detector; report stationary/near DSS candidate rate, not DSS false positives; no early stop or bisection change

projection.tangent: columns constant,sin,cos,frequency derivative,chirp derivative of fitted or true noiseless waveform; diagnostic uses true synthetic parameters; orthogonal projection onto tangent via SVD/QR; preserve original component amplitudes, not renormalize; test unconditional phase confidence intervals; additionally phase/chirp derivative-only projection after removing nuisance tangent
projection.interpretation: first-order tangent-space sensitivity diagnostic, not causal proof of covariance versus misspecification; orthogonal noise can have near-zero first-order parameter effect; report drift, SE, z moments, coverage and component energy

staging: transition and projection first; optimization comparison depends on transition engineering completion; no tuning on these results
